Portland, OR Missoula, MT Denver, CO Chicago, IL Atlanta, GA Washington, DC PeakInsights.com TO: Interested Parties FROM: Erik Iverson, President, Peak Insights RE: Senator Jim Risch Has Wide Lead in General Election Senate Race A recent statewide survey of likely 2026 general election voters (N=500 live calls; MoE +/-4%; June 6- 7, 2026) shows Senator Jim Risch leading by 40 points over his next closest competitor, Democrat David Roth. On the full-field ballot, Senator Risch also leads by wide margins over both Independent candidates (+48 Risch over Todd Achilles and +50% Risch over Natalie Fleming) and the Libertarian candidate (+53 Risch over Matt Loesby). June 6-7 Jim Risch, Republican 55% David Roth, Democratic 15% Todd Achilles, Independent 7% Natalie Fleming, Independent 5% Matt Loesby, Libertarian 2% None 1% Don't know 14% Senator Risch leads in all media markets, in both Congressional Districts, and among men and women of all age groups. Risch also has a wide lead among Republican voters and a nearly a 2:1 lead over his nearest competitor among Unaffiliated voters. Roth leads among Democrats. Senator Risch also has much higher name ID and favorability ratings than the other candidates. Risch Roth Achilles Fleming Loesby Favorable 46% 9% 10% 3% 1% Unfavorable 25% 3% 2% 2% 3% No opinion 14% 27% 19% 22% 20% Not aware 15% 61% 69% 73% 76% Methodology: The survey was conducted June 6-7, 2026, by Peak Insights. A total of 500 live phone interviews were conducted among a representative sample of likely 2026 general election voters in Idaho with a margin of error of +/-4%.
